ev.q: is a 2017 survival horror video game
praised the game for not relying on jumpscares
survive in a hideout against encroaching enemies
stealth and combat, as well as multiple storyline branches
crafting new items and upgrades at the workbench
Planning a defensive strategy is key
The storyline is shaped based on how the player reacts to the requests and actions of NPCs
killing and causing victims to transform into monsters and abominations
set somewhere in Poland in the late 1980s
Higher difficulties have higher penalties for death such as the loss of lives or permanent death
